The case: Liu2 purchased disabled persons' personal info (25,751 records) and phone, bank cards etc. Then used info to call, pretended to be civil affairs bureau staff, scammed victims to transfer money to accounts. So crimes: fraud (诈骗) for obtaining money by deception. Also illegal acquisition/sale of personal information: providing/obtaining personal data illegally. In Chinese criminal law, there is crime of "非法获取公民个人信息罪" (illegal acquisition of personal information) and "非法买卖公民个人信息罪". The facts: purchased personal info, used it. So crime: illegal acquisition of personal information (非法获取公民个人信息罪) and fraud (诈骗罪). Possibly also "诈骗" is already covered.
